final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) as order_count FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), total AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) as total_count FROM order_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT oc.ordertune, oc.order_count, CAST(oc.order_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total_count FROM total) as share FROM order_counts oc), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares), above_avg AS (SELECT ws.order_count, ws.share FROM with_shares ws WHERE ws.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM stats)) SELECT SUM(order_count) as sum_counts, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM stats)) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
